Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: pixel-art NPC sad speech-mouth atlas for a retro RPG portrait
Primary request: Create one 3-by-3 atlas of only this portrait's lower 64x29 face region. Row-major cells A, B, C / D, E, F / G, H, X. Give the same NPC a restrained sad delivery: gentle downturned lip corners and muted expression, without changing the face identity.
Input image: Use only the provided exact NPC074 mouth reference grid as the visual guide for the original muted lip color, small mouth scale, skin, jaw, nose edge, hair/blue ornament framing and native pixel clusters.
Subject: The same long light-brown/blond-haired fantasy NPC with a blue ornament along the left edge. Keep the source's soft warm palette and very small mouth scale.
Style/medium: Crisp restrained 1990s pixel-art portrait with hard pixel edges matching the reference; no smoothing or antialiasing.
Composition/framing: Exact 3x3 grid with nine equal cells, each matching a 64:29 landscape lower-face crop. Identical crop, scale and alignment in every cell; no gaps, borders, labels or text.
Constraints: Change only lips and the mouth interior within the natural mouth contour. Keep muted pink-brown lips, subdued gray-ivory teeth, natural skin transitions, jaw/nose/hair/ornament registration and stable sad expression. A and X are closed: A has gently pressed lips as for P/B/M; X is relaxed closed idle. B is a narrow opening with nearly together teeth for consonants/EE. C is a medium unrounded EH/AE opening. D is a wide AA opening. E is a slightly rounded AO/ER opening, no wider than C. F is a puckered UW/OW/W opening. G shows upper teeth touching the lower lip for F/V. H shows a raised tongue behind the upper teeth for L, with an opening between C and D. Use teeth only where the pose calls for them, muted and small; cavity stays dark and tongue stays subtle. Keep closed A/X simple and lip-sized. Avoid lipstick-red color, bright white teeth, big grin, exaggerated corners, broad mouth, extra shadow-brow or facial changes, teeth/tongue in poses that do not call for them, hair/skin/jaw edits, text, labels, watermark or antialiasing.
